column1: # stall-fields.tsv: the inventory of every field scripts/stall.sh reads from its four input documents (cls classify.json, disc discover.json, asks asks.sh --json, led the ledger).
# One line per field path: doc, path (dotted; * is any one key or index), the legal JSON types besides null (null is always legal), a class, a note. Class:
#   A  a wrong type there decides whether a lane, PR or ask is held, exempt, parked, relayed or routed: the validation stage (V_SPEC in stall.sh) names it in gaps[], everything is unverified, exit 3
#   B  display or time only: a wrong type drops only that value (the row keeps its other progress source, or is unverified): never a hold erased
#   G  the document gate (check_doc): a wrong type is a STALE-INPUT line, exit 3
# scripts/test/field-reads.sh checks every field name the stall.sh program reads against this file; scripts/test/stall-fuzz.sh mutates every path of
# the base fixture (scripts/test/stall-base.sh) that matches a line here. A field the program reads must be listed or the check fails.
